hideOverviews.title: Hide AI Overviews
hideOverviews.description: Hide the AI Overview box at the top of Google Search results. Default: true.

hideAiMode.title: Hide and block AI Mode
hideAiMode.description: Hide the AI Mode tab/button and send AI Mode (udm=50) links back to normal search. Default: true.

forceWebResults.title: Force plain Web results
forceWebResults.description: Rewrite ordinary searches to Google's 'Web' view (udm=14), which never shows AI Overviews. Removes some other widgets too. Default: false.
